english.meaning: add or put into a system
english.note: Use this when adding something into an existing system, mixture, or container.

exampleSentences.english: You can introduce the new data into the system later.
exampleSentences.traditional: 你遲啲可以將啲新資料加入個系統。
exampleSentences.jyutping: nei5 ci4 di1 ho2 ji5 zoeng1 di1 san1 zi1 liu6 gaa1 jap6 go3 hai6 tung2

english.note: Use this when adding a distinct or foreign element into a system, place, or process.

exampleSentences.english: They decided to inject a new element into the system.
exampleSentences.traditional: 佢哋決定將新元素加入系統。
exampleSentences.jyutping: keoi5 dei6 kyut3 ding6 zoeng1 san1 jyun4 sou3 gaa1 jap6 hai6 tung2
